title: Nostalgic Advancements
description: Brings back some of the deleted Advancements!
body:
### This DataPack adds some of the deleted Minecraft Advancements!

_Currently this DataPack adds:_


<details>
<summary>When Pigs Fly</summary>

Fly a pig of a cliff

</details>


<details>
<summary>Diamonds To You!</summary>

Give a diamond to another player (or zombie)

</details>


<details>
<summary>The Lie</summary>

Bake a cake

</details>


<details>
<summary>Overpowered!</summary>

Eat an Enchanted Golden Apple

</details>
